title: Whole genome sequencing of respiratory syncytial virus from clinical samples
author: Stephanie Goya
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bmhak32e
materials: Extract viral RNA from 200 μl of NPA by following the protocol PureLink viral RNA/DNA mini kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific) according the manufacturer’s instructions except for 2.8 μl of carrier RNA instead of 5.6 μl as recommended to reduce the presence of tRNA in the extracted RNA. Nevertheless, 140 μl of NPA should be used if QIAamp Viral RNA Mini Kit (Qiagen) is used instead of PureLink kit. In this case, no changes from the protocol should be done.
Extracted RNA can be storage at -80ºC.

4720 bp Forward 10469f: 5'-AGTyTkACAAGATATGGTGATCT-3' Reverse 15189r: 5'-AAGTGTCAAAAACTAATrTCTCGT-3' All the procedure should be done in ice. Amplify each fragment in an independent RT-PCR reaction with OneStep RT-PCR kit of Qiagen by mixing: primer f (25 μM)--- 0.6 μl primer r (25 μM)--- 0.6 μl RNA--- 6 μl Incubate at 65 °C for 5 min, then place 2 min in ice. Add (master mix can be done): H2O DNase/RNase free--- 5 μl Buffer 5X--- 10.55 μl RNAsa Inhibitor (40 U/μl)---0.25 μl dNTP mix (10 mM)--- 1 μl Enzime Mix--- 1 μl (Final volume: 25 μl) Incubate: 45 °C 30 min 95 °C 15 min 40 times: 94 °C 10 sec 55 °C 30 sec 68 °C 4.5 min 68 °C 10 min 4 °C hold

steps.title: Clarify Nasopharyngeal Aspirate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the nasopharyngeal aspirate (NPA) to remove cellular debris.

steps.title: Elute and Preserve Viral RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the viral-extracted RNA and add an inhibitor to preserve it.

substeps.instruction: Elute RNA in 40 μl of DNase/RNase-free water.
Add 1.25 μl of 40 U/μL RiboLock RNase Inhibitor (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

steps.title: Verify RT-PCR Product
steps.instruction: Run the RT-PCR product on an agarose gel for verification.

substeps.instruction: Run 4 μl of RT-PCR product on a 1.8% agarose gel stained with Ethidium Bromide.

steps.title: Clean up RT-PCR Product
steps.instruction: Perform a clean-up of the RT-PCR product using the DNA Clean & Concentrator kit (Zymo Research).

substeps.instruction: Elute with PCR-grade water; do not use buffer containing EDTA.

steps.title: Quantify Amplicons
steps.instruction: Quantify each amplicon using a Qubit dsDNA HS Assay.

steps.title: Prepare Sequencing Library
steps.instruction: Perform library preparation and final quantification using the NexteraXT kit (Illumina).

substeps.instruction: Follow NexteraXT kit instructions for library preparation.
Perform index addition by amplification and clean-up with Agencourt Ampure XP.
Quantify the libraries with the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Perform standard normalization instead of beads normalization (do not normalize with beads if library concentration is lower than 15 nM).
